snippet.title: Tied To The Beat Main Trailer | Version 1.0
snippet.description:
Tied to the Beat 1.0 is OUT NOW on Steam (released October 9, 2026): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4316340/

Tied To The Beat Version 1.0 launches on October 9, 2026!

A rhythm-powered survivor arena where your music becomes your weapon. Choose your songs, unleash powerful effects and survive endless waves of enemies.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4316340/Tied_to_the_Beat/

#TiedToTheBeat #IndieGame #SurvivorLike
